authority: INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md defines the stamp names. docs/EVALUATION.md defines the gates. This file records the arithmetic that constrains the detector configuration.

stamps.name: t0_final_blink_s
stamps.meaning: onset of the second blink of the pair

budgets.source: the responsiveness claim; this is the only interval the phrase 'sub-300 ms' may describe
must never be folded into any other interval

closure_arithmetic.statement: Under the double-only grammar, a decision cannot be committed until the sequence is closed, and closure requires observing that no third blink arrives within max_gap_s of the second.
closure_arithmetic.headroom_ms: 750 - 500 = 250 ms for filtering, scoring, hysteresis and dispatch
closure_arithmetic.consequence: Raising max_gap_s above 0.73 s makes the 750 ms p95 gate unreachable no matter how fast the classifier is. Any change to max_gap_s is a latency change, not only a grammar change, and must be reported as such.
closure_arithmetic.forbidden: Emitting on the second blink before closure to save latency. That converts every triple into a false activation and is the exact defect this grammar exists to prevent.

reporting_rules: Report armed exposure and elapsed monitored exposure separately; state which denominator any rate uses.
A scheduled onset is not an acoustic onset. Acoustic claims require loopback or microphone capture and must name the device.
Detector latency and musical boundary wait are reported as separate distributions, never summed into one headline number.
No sub-frame precision may be claimed from an 8 fps source video.
